sources.title: Qwen-Image-Lightning: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen-Image-Lightning is a LoRA-based speed optimization for the Qwen-Image text-to-image model, created by lightx2v. It uses step distillation to reduce inference from the standard ~50 steps to just 8 steps while maintaining image quality, generating 1024x1024 pixel images from text prompts using a flow-matching diffusion architecture with CLIP text encoding.
